text: After #857 merges, the factory's watchers and ask3d's pinned gate stay on builds from before it until #789's execution adapters and #910 have landed. With #857 alone, a factory drafting for a TypeScript or Python project classifies the bugs its issue reports as current, the gate then requires a replay nothing can run, and every such proposal would be ratified and then stop at the gate after a paid build. A gate pinned before #857 also fails a classified lock's ratification check. The dashboard moves with #857, since it only reads. @gitdek was told on 2026-11-13 and can say otherwise. Refines D-0470.
